Search scalar metrics/correctness and bounded evaluator-owned search evidence after fixed invocation. Native repair diagnostics only under exact draft-smoke/qualification flags. No test labels, baseline outputs or scores in RPC.

method.description: Fit masked low-rank score models and sequentially purchase up to k benchmark values per unseen model. MTEB checkpoints [1,2,4,8], OpenLLM [1,2,3], model/family-disjoint cases, 3 seeds each, actual and column-deranged training conditions, one trailing first-episode replay. Natural [0,1] MAE; target -> row -> checkpoint -> seed -> case -> source equal weights. Negative/inconclusive findings are legitimate: search.correct and final.correct require scientific execution validity, never beating a baseline. Final comparative claim assessment is separate. Production uses all eligible rows of pinned real sources, not synthetic stand-ins. CPython 3.12.15 Linux x86_64 validated; compatible Python>=3.11, no GPU or paid API. Native Landlock ABI>=1 and seccomp mandatory; 1 evaluator BLAS thread and up to3 candidate threads. No canonical minimum productive-baseline time is specified. Full score/operation-count tables, priors, fixed penalties and limitations are frozen in each resource plan.json. Largest declared complete request and response measured including base64, metadata, newline and 4096-byte extra envelope reserve. No state telemetry or mechanism claims from self-reports.

protocol.promotion_rule: At most3 idea cycles with at most1 production search evaluation each. Search eligibility is correct:true scientific execution validity, not comparative superiority or publication novelty. Rank eligible candidates by descending combined_score, exact ties earliest evaluated then lexicographic code SHA256. Freeze candidate/runtime/procedure before final. Harness owns promotion and publication. Every invocation: four ordered cases, actual then permuted, seed order within each condition; exactly one trailing replay reset of first seed as the last element of the declared full transcript. Arrays enumerate every reset including the sole replay; operation budgets include it. Draft smoke exactly first seed per case-condition plus the same single trailing replay. All reset records are global across clients/restarts.

required_evidence: Complete fixed production real-source episodes, baselines and nonvacuous controls, finite retained failure contributions, correct:true validity and single reproducible reset replay; smoke alone insufficient.

Pinned source versions and license/access caveats, normalized raw-document and complete model-example hash disjointness, alias/family and 70/30 within-plane splits, historical-only fitting and availability-conditioned eligibility; no resource-path RPC.

Actual selection and prediction method/code plus k-query ledgers and evaluator-computed error-versus-k/uncertainty; no candidate state or method-name self-report evidence. Comparisons must disclose ties, negative results, missing evidence and observational missingness.

Final superiority claims require positive paired family-clustered uncertainty against random lowrank, constant/copy and named reconstruction/selection ablations as appropriate; historical-structure attribution also requires supportive nonvacuous corruption control. No positive outcome is mandatory or retroactively a search gate.

Independent permitted literature review without searching/inferencing forbidden prior paper; actual experiment logs, reproducible data acquisition and code, environment versions, seeds, table/figure scripts, truthful failures and incomplete runs. Full paper PDF and LaTeX in latest official selected conference template with page-limit/checklist compliance; manual scientific review remains required.

Hard CPU/wall/memory/storage/RPC enforcement and broker transcripts are harness-owned. Native smoke validates bounded isolated transport but does not certify broker authentication or hidden candidate internals. No invented telemetry API.
